errors.error_description: State register uses a level-sensitive clock in the sensitivity list (always @(clk or negedge rst_n)) instead of an edge-specific clock, mixing asynchronous reset with improper sequential coding.
Within a clocked sequential block, a blocking assignment (shadow_sum = acc[7:0];) is used alongside non-blocking assignments, creating potential race conditions.
Combinational parity logic omits assignment in one case branch (S_DONE) without a default, inferring a latch.
A 16-bit value is assigned to a 4-bit output (assign dbg = acc;), causing truncation of the upper bits.
